scopes.platform: Outside any tenant. No workspace_id (or workspace_id kept only as a plain reference).
scopes.brand: workspace_id and brand_id NOT NULL; brand belongs to the workspace.
scopes.workspace_or_brand: workspace_id NOT NULL; brand_id nullable (null = workspace-scoped); scope_key = coalesce(brand_id, workspace_id).
scopes.personal: workspace_id and owner membership NOT NULL; may reference brand records but grants nothing.
scopes.personal_brand_optional: Personal ownership with optional brand_id (Inbox items, notes before filing).
scopes.inherited: Scope copied from the containing parent or host; workspace_id (and brand_id/scope_key where the parent has them) duplicated and enforced equal by composite foreign key.

lifecycles.full: Archive, trash, restore, purge through core.record.
lifecycles.mutable: Ordinary updates; removed with its container or by hard delete where no recovery is promised.
lifecycles.state-machine: Explicit states with allowed transitions; terminal states are final.
lifecycles.append-only: Insert only; never updated (except explicit redaction).
lifecycles.versioned-immutable: Each version row immutable; new versions appended.
lifecycles.ephemeral: Technical data with TTL or rebuildable projection.

concurrency.row-version: Optimistic: version column checked on update.
concurrency.field-merge: Optimistic per field: client sends base values; non-overlapping field changes merge.
concurrency.ordered: Fractional rank keys with deterministic tie-break.
concurrency.locked: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or advisory lock for a defined invariant.
concurrency.append-only: No updates; uniqueness constraints prevent duplicates.

retention_classes.R-LIVE: Lifecycle-governed customer data: archive/trash/purge by TRASH_RECOVERY_PERIOD and workspace deletion.
retention_classes.R-EVIDENCE: Immutable evidence: kept while its container exists; tombstone after purge; evidence-locked items block purge of the evidence while the locking decision exists.
retention_classes.R-AUDIT: Append-only audit; retention by audit policy (OD-36); content redacted explicitly on purge.
retention_classes.R-EXEC: Execution history (operations, attempts, AI/agent/automation runs, deliveries); retention policy (OD-36).
retention_classes.R-PERSONAL: Personal-scope data; deleted with account or membership (OD-39).
retention_classes.R-BILLING: Billing, invoices, usage for billing; legal retention independent of workspace (OD-36).
retention_classes.R-DERIVED: Rebuildable projections; purged with or rebuilt from sources.
retention_classes.R-EPHEMERAL: Technical TTL data (sessions, idempotency keys, outbox, tokens).

confidentiality.C1: Internal metadata: configuration, IDs, counts, operational state.
confidentiality.C2: Customer confidential: work content, comments, documents, files.
confidentiality.C3: Sensitive: personal data, billing details, security events, audit with values.
confidentiality.C4: Secret: credentials, keys, token hashes, MFA secrets. Never in ordinary records, logs, search, AI context, or exports.

export.admin: Exportable by owners/admins (eligible plans where stated).

search_ai.yes: Indexed and retrievable for AI within authorization.
search_ai.no: Never indexed or sent to AI.

secrets.possible: Untrusted input that may contain secrets; redaction applies before logs/AI/export.
secrets.hash-only: Stores only a one-way hash or prefix.
secrets.secret-ref: Stores only a reference to the secret store.

volume.very-high: Append-heavy; candidate for partitioning at platform scale

modules.name: Execution platform
modules.responsibilities: Logical operations and attempts, idempotency keys, durable job queue, transactional outbox and consumer inbox, external-effect ledger.

modules.name: Audit and activity
modules.responsibilities: Append-only audit events, explicit redactions, security events, user-facing activity projection.

modules.name: Record envelope and lifecycle
modules.responsibilities: Identity, public ID, scope, and lifecycle envelope for addressable records; archive cascades; deletion batches; tombstones; purge orchestration.

modules.name: Identity and accounts
modules.responsibilities: Accounts, credentials, MFA factors, sessions, OAuth identities, verification and recovery tokens.

modules.name: Workspaces and brands
modules.responsibilities: Workspaces, brands and brand settings, memberships, teams, invitations, ownership transfer.

modules.name: Grants and policy storage
modules.responsibilities: Role definitions and assignments, explicit record grants (shares), workspace sharing and feature policies. Evaluation semantics are owned by Phase 0C.

modules.name: Retention and governance
modules.responsibilities: Retention policy references, legal holds, deletion requests for accounts and workspaces.

modules.name: Usage metering and limits
modules.responsibilities: Usage events, period balances, spend limits, usage reservations for hard caps.

modules.name: Billing and entitlements
modules.responsibilities: Billing accounts, subscriptions, plans, entitlements, invoices, payment events, coupons. Billing records outlive workspaces.

modules.name: Workflows and custom fields
modules.responsibilities: Workflows, statuses mapped to fixed categories, transitions and rules with revisions, custom field definitions, field sets, typed values, calculated fields.

modules.name: Relationship primitives
modules.responsibilities: Typed record relationships (dependency, related), mentions and record links, followers.

modules.name: Files, deliverables, and evidence
modules.responsibilities: Stored objects, files and versions, attachments, external links, deliverables and versions, evidence items, storage usage.

modules.name: Comments and reviews
modules.responsibilities: Comments, threads, revisions, reactions, review requests with named reviewers, immutable per-reviewer decisions, and the append-only assignment history behind delegation and reassignment.

modules.name: Notifications
modules.responsibilities: Notifications, delivery attempts per channel, preferences, mutes, quiet hours, digests.

modules.name: Projects and tasks
modules.responsibilities: Projects (trees), phases, milestones, tasks (trees), assignees, checklists, criteria items, labels, project updates, decisions, reminders.

modules.name: Inbox and capture
modules.responsibilities: Personal Inbox items, notes, intake forms and submissions, email capture addresses, triage outcomes.

modules.name: Today, scheduling, and capacity
modules.responsibilities: Today commitments, daily records, work blocks, recurrence series, availability, holidays, time off, capacity reservations.

modules.name: Time tracking
modules.responsibilities: Time entries and timers, timesheets, per-brand approvals, period locks.

modules.name: Documents and knowledge
modules.responsibilities: Documents and page trees, immutable versions, approved-source verifications, suggestions.

modules.name: Goals and portfolios
modules.responsibilities: Goals, key results, goal links, check-ins, portfolios.

modules.name: Views and navigation state
modules.responsibilities: Saved views and query definitions, defaults, pins, favorites, recently viewed, persisted view state.

modules.name: Search
modules.responsibilities: Permission-filtered search projection fed by events, indexing status and failures, recent searches.

modules.name: Metrics, dashboards, and reports
modules.responsibilities: Versioned metric definitions, metric snapshots, dashboards, widgets, reports, schedules, report runs.

modules.name: Integrations, API, and webhooks
modules.responsibilities: Connections, resource mappings, external identities, external calendar-event mirrors, sync runs, checkpoints and conflicts, inbound endpoints and messages, outbound webhook subscriptions and deliveries, API tokens, OAuth/MCP clients.

modules.name: Import and export
modules.responsibilities: Import jobs, saved mappings, row outcomes and rollback, export jobs and expiring export files.

modules.name: Test management and defects
modules.responsibilities: Test cases and immutable versions, suites, runs, results, flaky classification, defect details, verification records.

modules.name: Development links and releases
modules.responsibilities: Development links, external code facts, environments, deployments, releases, scope, checklist, blocker waivers, immutable release decisions.

modules.name: Templates and onboarding
modules.responsibilities: Templates and immutable template versions, installations and provenance, sample data, onboarding progress.

modules.name: AI actions and briefings
modules.responsibilities: Provider configurations, brand AI profiles, AI actions, context references, outputs, change proposals, briefings and statements, corrections.

modules.name: Automations
modules.responsibilities: Automation definitions with immutable versions, runs and step runs.

modules.name: Agents and execution control
modules.responsibilities: Agent profiles, scope and tool grants, connectors, assignments, runs, tool calls, artifacts, action approvals, emergency stop.

modules.name: Support and feedback
modules.responsibilities: Support requests, consented diagnostics bundles, feedback, platform content (help, changelog, roadmap, status).

entities.name: operation
entities.purpose: One logical operation (AI action, agent run, automation run, sync, import, export, bulk edit, brand move, purge, webhook delivery). Carries the single logical outcome.
uniqueness: (workspace_id, kind, dedupe_key) where state is non-terminal
entities.notes: Typed detail tables (ai_action, agent_run, automation_run, sync_run, import_job, export_job, brand_move) are 1:1 with operation. Execution-context columns mirror the 0D execution-context schema; JSON columns are limited to the validated delegation chain and selected scope.

entities.name: attempt
entities.purpose: One try within an operation. Retries add attempts, never operations.

entities.name: idempotency_key
entities.purpose: Deduplicates client and API writes; maps a key to its logical operation and stored response.
entities.notes: Replay returns the stored status and resource references re-rendered through current authorization, never a stored body (PC-02).

entities.name: outbox_event
entities.purpose: Domain fact written in the same transaction as the state change; dispatched asynchronously.
entities.notes: Deleted after dispatch plus a short replay window. Payloads reference records; they never carry secrets.

entities.name: inbox_receipt
entities.purpose: Consumer-side dedupe: one row per (consumer, event).

entities.name: external_effect
entities.purpose: Ledger of side effects outside the product (message, publish, charge, PR comment, calendar write) guaranteeing at-most-once execution per logical operation.
entities.notes: 'unknown' moves the operation to waiting for human confirmation; never auto-resent.

entities.name: job
entities.purpose: Durable background job (database-backed queue) with leases, backoff, dead-letter state and per-workspace fairness.
entities.notes: workspace_id is nullable only for platform jobs. Carries the full execution context (0D AQ-03); handlers re-check live authorization before consequential steps.

entities.name: audit_event
entities.purpose: Append-only material event: who or what did what to which target, when, through which operation.
entities.notes: No foreign keys to targets, so events survive purge. UPDATE/DELETE revoked from application roles.

entities.name: audit_redaction
entities.purpose: Explicit, append-only record that content values inside audit events were redacted (purge, privacy request) and why.

entities.name: security_event
entities.purpose: Security-relevant events (sign-in, MFA, token use, permission and sharing changes, export).
entities.notes: workspace_id is null for account-level events before workspace selection.

entities.name: activity_item
entities.purpose: User-facing projection of audit events for a record feed, with display-safe values and permission keys.
entities.notes: Rebuildable from audit_event. Read-time authorization still applies per target.

entities.name: record
entities.purpose: Envelope for every addressable record: identity, public ID, type, scope keys, lifecycle, provenance. Carries no domain fields.
entities.notes: Typed tables share the record id (1:1) and carry duplicated workspace_id, brand_id, scope_key and lifecycle_state, enforced by a deferrable composite foreign key.

entities.name: deletion_batch
entities.purpose: One trash action and its contained subtree; restores and purges as a unit.

entities.name: archive_batch
entities.purpose: One archive action and the records archived by cascade under it.

entities.name: brand_move
entities.purpose: Operation detail for moving a record subtree to another brand: mappings, re-validated links, outcome.

entities.name: account
entities.purpose: A person's sign-in identity across workspaces.

entities.name: credential
entities.purpose: Password hash and parameters. Separate table with column privileges.

entities.name: mfa_factor
entities.purpose: MFA factor (TOTP secret reference, WebAuthn credential), recovery-code hashes.

entities.name: session
entities.purpose: Authenticated session with device metadata; revocable remotely.

entities.name: oauth_identity
entities.purpose: Link between an account and an external identity provider subject.

entities.name: verification_token
entities.purpose: Email verification, password reset, invitation acceptance tokens (hashed, expiring).

entities.name: step_up_challenge
entities.purpose: Step-up challenge and single-use verified token bound to session, membership, action key, and target.
entities.notes: 0D §11.2. Tokens are stored only as hashes. `locked` is a stored terminal state, set atomically by the failed attempt that reaches STEP_UP_MAX_ATTEMPTS.

entities.name: workspace
entities.purpose: Tenant root: settings (name, logo, timezone, locale, currency, week start), subscription link, owners.
entities.notes: The workspace row is the tenant root and is not a core.record; its own lifecycle is the workspace deletion workflow.

entities.name: brand
entities.purpose: A business or product line inside a workspace, with identity, settings, and timezone.
entities.notes: For the brand row, brand_id = id. operational_status is business metadata only (ADR-19): archive, trash, and purge are core.record.lifecycle_state and are never represented by operational_status.

entities.name: membership
entities.purpose: An account's membership in a workspace with kind (member, guest) and state.
entities.notes: Phase 1D: state transitions invited→active, active→suspended→active, active|suspended→removed (terminal). A removed membership keeps its row for audit and ownership history; it never regains authority (a new invitation reactivates it as a fresh active state only through invitation.accept). Guests never hold role assignments.

entities.name: team
entities.purpose: Named group of memberships; may span brands; is a grant holder, never a scope.
entities.notes: Addressable core.record extension (brand_id NULL, workspace scope). Teams may span brands but are never a scope; they are grantees of role assignments and record grants. Phase 1D.

entities.name: team_member
entities.purpose: Membership in a team.
entities.notes: Internal memberships only (guests may not join teams that hold scope grants). Removed with team membership changes and on departure; a removal bumps the member's principal epoch.

entities.name: invitation
entities.purpose: Pending invitation by email with intended role and scope.
key_columns: role_key text (built-in workspace role for members; null for guests)
scope_proposal jsonb (brand access levels for members; fixed record shares for guests)
token_id uuid (identity.verification_token; the raw token is never stored)
entities.notes: Phase 1D. One pending invitation per (workspace, email_key). Resend issues a new single-use token that supersedes the previous one (identity token lineage); the invitation row keeps its ID. Acceptance requires the authenticated verified account's normalized email to equal email_key (0C AZ-19).

entities.name: ownership_transfer
entities.purpose: Workspace ownership transfer request and acceptance.
entities.notes: Phase 1D. At most one pending transfer per workspace. Acceptance by the recipient (ownership.accept, step-up) atomically adds the owner role and optionally demotes the previous owner to administrator; last-owner protection holds throughout. Immutable after a terminal state.

entities.name: brand_setting
entities.purpose: Typed brand settings: working calendar reference, goals/priorities text, notification rules defaults.

entities.name: scope_preference
entities.purpose: Per person per workspace: the last selected brand or all-brands context. Revalidated against current authorization on every use; never grants access.
entities.notes: Phase 1C. Upserted on its primary key (row lock); the latest selection wins. A stale or unauthorized brand falls back to the first authorized active brand; it never broadens to all brands. Phase 1E: the URL scope (`scope=all|brand:{id}|brands:{id},…`) is authoritative on scope-sensitive pages and is validated and normalized server-side on every request; the per-device default lives in view_state (`shell.scope`), and this row remains the cross-device fallback and the directory's most-recent-workspace signal.

entities.name: role
entities.purpose: Role definition (system or custom) with permission set; semantics owned by 0C.

entities.name: role_assignment
entities.purpose: Assignment of a role to a principal (membership, team) at a scope (workspace, brand, project, record).
entities.notes: Break-glass elevation (0C access.elevate_sensitive) is an elevated, reasoned, time-boxed assignment (expires_at required when elevated); principal_type includes membership, team, service_principal. Guests never receive role assignments (0C AZ-06).

entities.name: share_group
entities.purpose: One share action: sharer, source record, recipient, default level, expiry; groups the per-record grant rows created at share time.
entities.notes: Public ID prefix shr (0D registry). Revoking the group revokes all its grant rows in one transaction.

entities.name: record_grant
entities.purpose: One explicit grant on exactly one record (share). Rows are created per record selected at share time and grouped by share_group; never derived by traversal.
key_columns: grantee_key uuid (= grantee_id; indexed for semi-joins)
entities.notes: Never implies onward sharing or ownership change. Selected children each receive their own row in the same share group at share time; records created later are never included (approved decision, 0C AZ-05). Indexes: (workspace_id, record_id, grantee_key) and (workspace_id, grantee_key, record_id) where state = 'active'.

entities.name: field_policy
entities.purpose: Field visibility/edit policy for a record type at a scope (workspace, brand, project): read/edit thresholds, guest visibility, search indexing.
key_columns: field_key text (core field key or custom field id)
entities.notes: 0C §7.1. Public ID prefix fpol (0D registry). Calculated-field visibility is derived from its dependencies' policies, never stored separately. Field keys are validated by the access command against the core field catalog and workflow.field_definition (no cross-layer foreign key; retired field IDs remain valid). Phase 2C implements it for custom field definitions (field_key = definition id): read and edit minimum levels and guest visibility. Formula visibility is the intersection of its inputs.

entities.name: permission_epoch
entities.purpose: Monotonic permission epochs (workspace, principal, agent class) bumped transactionally with every authorization change; read on every request, step, and tool call.
key_columns: subject_id uuid null (principal id; null for workspace and agent_class)
entities.notes: 0C §13.5. Epochs never decrease. Internal only (no public ID).

entities.name: service_principal
entities.purpose: Workspace service identity used by service API tokens: explicit grants and capabilities, accountable owner, suspension when the owner loses authority.
entities.notes: 0C §9.6. Public ID prefix svc (0D registry). Grants are role_assignment rows whose principal is this service principal.

entities.name: support_access_grant
entities.purpose: Customer-issued, time-boxed, read-only-by-default access for platform support; every support action is evaluated as support_operator ∩ this grant.
key_columns: brand_ids uuid[] null (null = all non-sensitive brands)
entities.notes: 0C §2.5. Never covers personal records or secrets. Public ID prefix sag (0D registry).

entities.name: workspace_policy
entities.purpose: Typed workspace policy settings (sharing, guests, exports, tokens, AI/agents, self-approval, billing administration, archive comments, defaults).
key_columns: require_independent_for text[] (risk classes or 0C action keys)
entities.notes: One typed column per policy key (0C AC-03); no untyped settings bag. Defaults are the 0C safe defaults; values are configuration, not promises.

entities.name: retention_policy
entities.purpose: Named retention parameters per data class and plan; values unset until approved (no hard-coded durations).
key_columns: period interval null (null = not yet decided; purge disabled)

entities.name: legal_hold
entities.purpose: Reserved extension point: blocks purge for a scope (OD-37 undecided; not exposed at launch).

entities.name: deletion_request
entities.purpose: Account or workspace deletion workflow with grace period, export offer, and purge operation link.

entities.name: usage_event
entities.purpose: Append-only metered usage (AI tokens/cost, agent run, automation run, storage delta, API call) attributed to brand, actor, and operation.

entities.name: usage_balance
entities.purpose: Per workspace (and optionally brand) per period per meter: allowance, consumed, reserved.

entities.name: spend_limit
entities.purpose: Configured monthly allowances, alert thresholds, and hard caps for AI, agents, automations.

entities.name: usage_reservation
entities.purpose: Hold against a balance for an estimated expensive run; settled or released on terminal state.

entities.name: billing_account
entities.purpose: Commercial counterparty: billing details, tax IDs, provider customer reference. Survives workspace purge.
entities.notes: Not cascaded by workspace deletion; workspace_id kept as a plain reference.

entities.name: plan
entities.purpose: Platform plan catalog version with entitlements and prices (data, not code).

entities.name: subscription
entities.purpose: Workspace subscription state, plan version, seats, period, cancellation, grace and read-only windows.

entities.name: entitlement_grant
entities.purpose: Effective server-enforced entitlement values for a workspace (from plan, add-on, override).

entities.name: invoice
entities.purpose: Invoice and receipt mirror from the payment provider; immutable once issued.

entities.name: payment_event
entities.purpose: Provider webhook facts (payment succeeded/failed, dispute) deduplicated by provider event ID.

entities.name: coupon_redemption
entities.purpose: Coupon or founder offer applied, with explicit duration and renewal terms snapshot.

entities.name: workflow
entities.purpose: Statuses, transitions, and rules for a record type at a scope (workspace, brand, project).
uniqueness: one active workflow per (workspace, scope_kind, brand_id, project_id, record_kind)
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). Resolution is the most specific applicable scope: project → brand → workspace → platform default. Changing scope never changes record authority. Archive is reversible; purge is refused while records use its statuses.

entities.name: workflow_status
entities.purpose: A status with fixed category, color, order. Category is immutable; retire instead of delete.
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). A record's status_id references a platform status or a workflow status (trigger-checked, delete-guarded). The category is fixed; a status in use is archived, never deleted, until records are migrated.

entities.name: platform_status
entities.purpose: Immutable platform-default statuses per record type (projects in 2A: Planned, Active, On hold, Completed, Cancelled).
entities.notes: Phase 2A (ADR-21): seeded by migration only; Phase 2C adds workspace workflows and custom statuses. Phase 2C: unchanged immutable seeds; never copied into workflow_status.

entities.name: transition
entities.purpose: A directed from-status → to-status rule of a workflow, with required fields, confirmation, and approval policy.
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). Once a workflow has an active transition, only registered edges are allowed. Replaces the planned workflow_revision snapshot: transitions are versioned rows and approval requests bind to the transition version.

entities.name: transition_requirement
entities.purpose: A field that must be present for a transition (built-in key or custom field definition).
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). Checked on the final merged record under lock, before any mutation.

entities.name: transition_approver
entities.purpose: A named approver of a transition (all_named_approvers).
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). Naming an approver grants no record access.

entities.name: approval_request
entities.purpose: An immutable request to apply one transition to one record version.
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). Facts are immutable except a one-time close. State (pending, approved, rejected, stale, expired, applied, withdrawn) is derived from decisions, the record version, and time.

entities.name: approval_decision
entities.purpose: An immutable approve or reject decision on an approval request.
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). One decision per approver per request; never updated or deleted by application roles.

entities.name: formula_dependency
entities.purpose: An explicit edge from a formula field definition to a field it reads.
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). Cycle-checked at save (service plus deferred database guard); bounded by FORMULA_DEPTH_MAX and FORMULA_REFS_MAX.

entities.name: field_definition
entities.purpose: Custom field definition with immutable type and validation rules; retire instead of delete.
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). Formula is a field type (OD-11), not a second system. Fields from broader scopes accumulate unless shadowed by a narrower definition with the same lineage_id; names are not identity. Purge is refused while values or references exist.

entities.name: field_option
entities.purpose: Option of a select or multi-select field.
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). Stable identity; renaming keeps stored meaning. Removing an in-use option needs a replacement (bounded migration) or archival.

entities.name: field_set
entities.purpose: Reusable bundle of field definitions.
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). Versioned; applying attaches a version snapshot without copying definitions or values.

entities.name: field_set_version
entities.purpose: An immutable ordered snapshot of a field set's definitions and presentation overrides.
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23).

entities.name: field_set_attachment
entities.purpose: A record's attachment to one field set version (lineage, not a copy).
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). Later set versions never change attached records until a manager explicitly upgrades them with a preview.

entities.name: field_value
entities.purpose: One typed value per (record, field); exactly one typed column populated per field type.
entities.notes: Phase 2C (ADR-23). One canonical relation, never a column per field. Typed columns are normalized copies for filtering and sorting. Formula results are computed rows (read-only). Person and label values reference identities but grant no access.

entities.name: record_relationship
entities.purpose: Typed association between two records (blocks, related); stores both endpoint brands for permission-safe filtering.
entities.notes: Never used for authorization. Cycle prevention applies to 'blocks' (no dependency cycles) via transactional check.

entities.name: label
entities.purpose: Free-form classifier at workspace or brand scope.
entities.notes: Phase 2B (ADR-22, OD-10): one concept for labels and tags, scoped to exactly one brand. Renames keep identity; archived labels stay on tasks and leave default pickers. Labels never grant authority.

entities.name: task_label
entities.purpose: Label applied to a record.
entities.notes: Phase 2B (ADR-22): replaces the generic label_assignment; labels apply to tasks only until another record type registers them.

entities.name: mention
entities.purpose: Reference from authored content (comment, document version, description) to a record, person, team, or agent.
entities.notes: Phase 4A (ADR-31): resolved only to what the author may name in the host record's scope; shown only while the viewer can see the target; `notified` is 4B's flag. Document and record-field sources arrive with 4C.

entities.name: record_link
entities.purpose: Non-blocking reference to a record or external URL from a record (documents to tasks, goals, external records).
key_columns: target_record_id null (a registered, independently readable record type)
entities.notes: Target is a record or a URL. Phase 2B implements safe https URL links on tasks; record targets (documents, files, external records) are offered only once their owning record type exists and is independently readable. Links to synced external objects use the target record that integrations.external_identity maps.

entities.name: follower
entities.purpose: Person following a record (canonical term for watcher).
entities.notes: Phase 4A (ADR-31, OD-10): one explicit subscription per person and record; never inherited from membership, assignment, ownership, or a share; an unreadable follow is inert and never reported. Notification preferences are 4B.

entities.name: file_object
entities.purpose: Immutable stored object in object storage: key, checksum, size, content type, scan state, encryption.

entities.name: file
entities.purpose: Addressable file with metadata and version chain; attached to exactly one host.

entities.name: file_version
entities.purpose: One immutable version of a file pointing to a file_object or external URL.

entities.name: upload_session
entities.purpose: Upload session: declared name/type/size/checksum, host, signed-URL issuance, verification and outcome.
entities.notes: 0D §15.1. Signed URLs are not stored.

entities.name: deliverable
entities.purpose: Designated output of a task with expected type and current review state.

entities.name: deliverable_version
entities.purpose: Submitted iteration of a deliverable (file version, URL, or artifact) with review state; accepted versions are evidence-locked.

entities.name: evidence_item
entities.purpose: Evidence attached to a subject (test result, defect, release decision, review, environment) with lock state.

entities.name: storage_usage
entities.purpose: Per-workspace storage totals for limits (rollup).

entities.name: comment
entities.purpose: Comment or threaded reply on exactly one host record (a task or a project until later phases register more); a deleted comment is a tombstone.
key_columns: root_comment_id null (thread root; replies never nest deeper)
body_rich jsonb null (rich-text v1; null once deleted)
entities.notes: Phase 4A (ADR-31): flat threads; the author edits or deletes only inside COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MINUTES (OD-38), moderators (manage) delete but never edit; deletion clears the body and keeps the prior body in comment_revision. Authorized through the host record on every read. Purge removes the content; audit keeps hashes only.

entities.name: comment_revision
entities.purpose: Prior body of an edited or deleted comment (retention per OD-38).
entities.notes: Phase 4A (ADR-31, OD-38): append-only prior bodies; readable by the author and by people with comment.moderate on the host; removed with the host on purge.

entities.name: reaction
entities.purpose: Reaction on a comment from a fixed vocabulary (thumbs_up, heart, celebrate, eyes, check, question, thanks, laugh).
entities.notes: Phase 4A (ADR-31): set or cleared only by the person themselves; lists show counts and the viewer's own reactions, never who else reacted.

entities.name: review_request
entities.purpose: Request to review or approve one version of a record (a task or a project until later phases register more), with named reviewers and a rule.
uniqueness: (subject_record_id) where state = requested (one open request per record)
entities.notes: Phase 4A (ADR-31): decisions are bound to the version reviewed; the request settles at most once; refresh supersedes an open request. Does not change the record's status (workflow approvals, 2C, stay the status gate).

entities.name: review_decision
entities.purpose: Immutable decision by one named reviewer on a review request (approved, changes_requested, or rejected) with a self-approval flag.
uniqueness: (review_request_id, reviewer_membership_id) one decision per named reviewer
entities.notes: Phase 4A (ADR-31): replaces the single terminal decision of the Phase 0 sketch; with the `all` rule several reviewers decide and the request settles once.

entities.name: review_reviewer
entities.purpose: A reviewer named on a review request (an active internal member who could decide at request time).
entities.notes: Phase 4A (ADR-31): a departing reviewer who has not decided is removed from open requests; decided reviewers stay as history.

entities.name: assignment_event
entities.purpose: Append-only fact that responsibility for a task was assigned, removed, reassigned, or delegated.
entities.notes: Phase 4A (ADR-31): readable only through ownership of the task (history is outside a share); people are named only to members. Removed with the task on purge.

entities.name: notification
entities.purpose: One notification for one recipient about one event; content re-authorized at delivery and display.
key_columns: facts jsonb (IDs and small scalars only, never titles; NOTIFY_FACTS_MAX_BYTES)
entities.notes: Phase 4B (ADR-32): the row stores identifiers and small facts, never titles or bodies; the summary is rendered at display from what the recipient can read now and an unreadable record shows only that access is gone. Created only for an active recipient who can read the record (security notices excepted); repeats inside NOTIFY_DEDUPE_WINDOW_MINUTES collapse and reopen read or dismissed rows, while saved stays saved. Ages out after NOTIFY_RETENTION_DAYS except saved; erased with the person.

entities.name: notification_delivery
entities.purpose: Delivery per channel (email, browser, digest email) with outcome, bounded retry, and reconciliation state.
entities.notes: Phase 4B (ADR-32): delivered only after the provider (or the person's own browser) acknowledges; an unconfigured provider is suppressed with a reason, never delivered. Failures carry a class and a bounded code, never content or addresses; retries back off exponentially up to NOTIFY_DELIVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS and then dead-letter for administrator review. Content is re-authorized at send time.

entities.name: notification_preference
entities.purpose: Per person: event x scope x channel mode (immediate, digest, muted), quiet hours, timezone source.
entities.notes: Phase 4B (ADR-32): the most specific scope wins (record, project, brand, workspace), then an exact type over *, then an exact channel over all; security notices cannot be muted; a mute can expire.

entities.name: digest
entities.purpose: Generated digest bundle for a recipient and period.
entities.notes: Phase 4B (ADR-32): one cadence per person, so one digest carries each item; its items are re-authorized at assembly and again when sent, and unreadable items are left out.

entities.name: notification_profile
entities.purpose: Per person: time zone source, quiet hours, digest cadence and times, email and browser switches, browser permission.
entities.notes: Phase 4B (ADR-32): quiet hours hold non-security email and browser delivery only, never the in-app centre or a permission or share notice.

entities.name: notification_scope_default
entities.purpose: Brand or project default mode for an event type and channel, set by those who manage the scope; a person's own choice overrides it.
entities.notes: Phase 4B (ADR-32): ranks below every personal preference and above the system default; changes are audited.

entities.name: project
entities.purpose: Bounded body of work in one brand; may have a parent project in the same brand.
uniqueness: (recurrence_series_id, occurrence_key) where recurrence_series_id is not null
key_columns: depth smallint (root = 0; PROJECT_DEPTH_MAX enforced by commands, hard ceiling 32 in the database)
intake_source_id null (validated intake_form record; provenance, PRJ-017)
entities.notes: Phase 2A (ADR-21): collaborator authority is project-scoped access.role_assignment only (no project_member table); owner_membership_id is responsibility and is paired with an explicit project manage grant; a deferred guard keeps one eligible manager on every active project. Completion is derived (OD-13), never stored as authorization.

entities.name: phase
entities.purpose: Ordered stage of a project; reversible archive distinct from trash (ADR-21).
entities.notes: Phase 2A (ADR-21): archive and restore use the canonical core.record lifecycle; archived phases keep their rank and history.

entities.name: milestone
entities.purpose: Dated checkpoint in a project.

entities.name: task
entities.purpose: Unit of work: exactly one brand, optional project, optional parent task; defects are task_type = defect.
key_columns: project_id null (same workspace and brand; subtasks share their parent's project identity)
parent_task_id null (same workspace, brand, and project identity)
depth smallint (root = 0; TASK_DEPTH_MAX enforced by commands, hard ceiling 64 in the database)
deadline_date date | deadline_at timestamptz + deadline_tz (never changed implicitly)
origin_ref jsonb (safe identifiers only: series, occurrence, template, version; immutable)
last_meaningful_update_at timestamptz (OD-17 freshness; maintained by triggers)
entities.notes: Phase 2B (ADR-22): phase/milestone association, task types, manual blocked reasons, due times, recurrence, and freshness fields are not part of 2B; they arrive with their owning phases. Scheduled time is a planning work block (3C), never a task column. Phase 2D (ADR-24): task origin is a closed kind with safe metadata, immutable except through a registered migration; freshness is a trigger-maintained column; repeated rescheduling is derived from the audit ledger.

entities.name: task_assignee
entities.purpose: Person assigned to a task (multiple allowed). Agent assignment is agents.agent_assignment.
key_columns: membership_id (active internal member; never a guest)
is_primary boolean (at most one per task)
delegated_from_membership_id null (set when the assignment was handed over, 4A)
entities.notes: Responsibility only, never authority (0C AZ-22). Removed or suspended members' assignments end on departure. Phase 4A: delegation records who handed the assignment over; every change is also an append-only collab.assignment_event.

entities.name: checklist_item
entities.purpose: Lightweight checkbox in a task.
entities.notes: Ordered facts of a task, not tasks: no assignees, dates, or dependencies, and no effect on task status.

entities.name: criteria_item
entities.purpose: Acceptance criterion, definition-of-done item, or success criterion on a task or project.
key_columns: project_id null / task_id null (exactly one, per owner_kind)
kind (success|definition_of_done for projects; acceptance|definition_of_done for tasks)
entities.notes: Phase 2B (ADR-22): project definition-of-done items apply to the project's tasks as read-only inherited defaults, evaluated at read time and never copied; a task records whether each inherited item is met or dismissed (work.task_inherited_criterion).

entities.name: task_inherited_criterion
entities.purpose: A task's response to an inherited project definition-of-done item: met or explicitly dismissed (ADR-22).
key_columns: criteria_item_id (a definition-of-done item of the task's project)

entities.name: scope_item
entities.purpose: Project scope statement, exclusion, risk, assumption, or constraint (PRJ-006).
entities.notes: Phase 2A (ADR-21): ordered and mutable; text is audited as content (hash only).

entities.name: project_update
entities.purpose: Status update for a project; append-only. Verified only by a separate human verification fact (OD-16, decided).

entities.name: project_update_verification
entities.purpose: Append-only fact that an authorized human verified a project update (OD-16).
entities.notes: Phase 2A (ADR-21): authoring alone never verifies; AI, imported, and system drafts stay unverified until this fact exists.

entities.name: decision_record
entities.purpose: Structured decision or open question in a project or brand (OD-15, decided).
key_columns: outcome text null (decision outcome or question resolution)
entities.notes: Phase 2A (ADR-21): cross-kind states are rejected by the database and the service; documents may link later but are not the authority.

entities.name: inbox_item
entities.purpose: Raw captured input owned by one person; brand optional until triage; preserves original text and source.
key_columns: source_ref text null (safe public ID: batch, form)
entities.notes: Phase 2E (ADR-25): personal; visible only to its owner (OD-03), brand optional until triage. raw_text, source, and correlation are immutable (trigger). Merged and discarded items are kept; nothing is deleted by triage.

entities.name: note
entities.purpose: Lightweight note; personal until filed to a brand, project, or task.
entities.notes: Phase 2E (ADR-25): personal until filed (OD-03 rule). Converting a note to a task or project keeps the note and records the conversion.

entities.name: intake_form
entities.purpose: Brand-owned intake form definition (public submission rules pending OD-28).
entities.notes: Phase 2E (ADR-25): members-only while OD-28 is open; submissions land in the queue owner's Inbox with the form's brand.

entities.name: intake_submission
entities.purpose: Submission received by a form, routed into the brand intake queue.
entities.notes: Phase 2E (ADR-25): append-only receipt linking a submission to the Inbox item it created; the text lives on the item.

entities.name: email_capture_address
entities.purpose: Personal forwarding address and verified senders (pending OD-29).

entities.name: today_commitment
entities.purpose: A person's commitment to an item on a day (in their timezone and day-start offset) with manual order.
entities.notes: Phase 3C (ADR-29): never changes the task's dates; closed commitments are final.

entities.name: daily_record
entities.purpose: Immutable end-of-day snapshot of planned versus completed work and time.
entities.notes: Phase 3C (ADR-29): written once at shutdown or by the day-close job; never rewritten.

entities.name: work_block
entities.purpose: Reserved calendar time for a task (or none, as a reservation); moving it never changes due date or deadline.
key_columns: brand_id null (= the task's brand; cascades with the task)
entities.notes: Phase 3C (ADR-29): personal. The seeded core record type stays reserved: 3C blocks carry their own public ID and are deleted with audit (no trash), and removed with their task. Focus blocks are protected against overlap by a guard under the person's lock. Calendar and AI sources are 6C and 7F.

entities.name: block_series
entities.purpose: A person's recurring work block (CAL-005): a rule in an anchor zone, a duration, and block settings.
entities.notes: Phase 3C (ADR-29): occurrences are work blocks keyed (series_id, occurrence_key), generated idempotently through BLOCK_SERIES_HORIZON_DAYS.

entities.name: recurrence_series
entities.purpose: Recurrence rule anchored to an IANA timezone with template, mode, and split lineage.
key_columns: project_id null (task series: the project generated tasks join; same brand)
template_payload jsonb (typed per target; frozen at definition, immutable)
last_run_at timestamptz (discovery fairness: oldest-waiting first; operational, not versioned)
entities.notes: Phase 2A (ADR-21): template_payload is copied once from an approved template or project serialization and never updated; occurrences carry (recurrence_series_id, occurrence_key), unique per target table; catch-up is bounded by RECURRENCE_CATCHUP_MAX. Phase 2D (ADR-24): target_kind task is implemented; occurrences are work.task rows.

entities.name: recurrence_exception
entities.purpose: Skip, move, or override for one occurrence key.

entities.name: availability_rule
entities.purpose: Recurring weekly working windows for a person in their timezone, with effective dates.
entities.notes: Phase 3E (ADR-30): non-overlapping windows (guard trigger); evaluated per date in the person's zone, so DST days have their real length.

entities.name: brand_calendar
entities.purpose: Brand working hours, timezone reference, and holidays.
entities.notes: Phase 3E (ADR-30): the brand zone (tenancy.brand.timezone) and planning.holiday serve as the brand calendar; brand working hours stay with 1C/6C.

entities.name: holiday
entities.purpose: Holiday date for a person or brand calendar (manual at launch, OD-19).
entities.notes: Phase 3E (ADR-30, OD-19): manual brand holidays; they reduce a person's availability when the person observes brand holidays and holds a reservation in that brand.

entities.name: time_off
entities.purpose: Typed unavailable period for a person.
entities.notes: Phase 3E (ADR-30): personal; others with capacity.view see only unavailable minutes, never kinds or labels.

entities.name: capacity_reservation
entities.purpose: Planned share or minutes of a person's capacity for one brand per period (soft target).
entities.notes: Phase 3E (ADR-30): a weekly planning target; exceeding it warns and never blocks.

entities.name: time_entry
entities.purpose: Actual time on one task or one project in that work's brand: manual (timed or duration-only) or a timer (running, paused, stopped).
uniqueness: one live timer per membership: unique (workspace_id, membership_id) where state in (running, paused)
entities.notes: Phase 3D (ADR-27). The brand is part of the target foreign key (ON UPDATE CASCADE), so a task moved to another brand carries its entries; the lock guard refuses the move while any is submitted or approved. Submitted/locked state is derived from timesheet and period_lock rows (not stored).

entities.name: time_segment
entities.purpose: One UTC interval of a timed entry (half-open; an open segment is a running timer).
entities.notes: Phase 3D (ADR-27): segments of one person never overlap (database guard under the person lock).

entities.name: timesheet
entities.purpose: Person and period container spanning brands; submitted and approved per brand line.
entities.notes: Phase 3D (ADR-27): seven-day periods starting on the workspace week start; per-brand lines in timesheet_line.

entities.name: timesheet_line
entities.purpose: One brand's part of a submitted timesheet: its state and the submitted totals and hash.
entities.notes: Phase 3D (ADR-27).

entities.name: timesheet_approval
entities.purpose: Per-brand approval of a timesheet's entries; immutable decision row.
entities.notes: Phase 3D (ADR-27): immutable evidence of exactly which entries were decided.

entities.name: period_lock
entities.purpose: Lock on approved period for a person and brand; unlock is an audited new row.
entities.notes: Phase 3D (ADR-27): the latest row per (person, brand, period) decides; unlock needs a reason and step-up (OD-26).

entities.name: document
entities.purpose: Rich-text document or page; workspace or brand scope, optionally attached to a project or task; page tree.

entities.name: document_version
entities.purpose: Immutable content snapshot with hash.

entities.name: source_approval
entities.purpose: Verification that a specific document version is an approved AI source.

entities.name: document_suggestion
entities.purpose: Proposed edit on a document version; accepted or rejected by owner.

entities.name: goal
entities.purpose: Desired outcome at workspace, brand, or project scope with owner, period, baseline, target, unit.

entities.name: key_result
entities.purpose: Measurable target within a goal.

entities.name: goal_link
entities.purpose: Association from goal or key result to project or task (brand goals link within their brand).

entities.name: goal_checkin
entities.purpose: Append-only progress update with confidence and source (manual or computed).

entities.name: portfolio
entities.purpose: Saved, permission-filtered collection of projects.

entities.name: saved_view
entities.purpose: Stored query AST plus presentation; personal or shared to a scope. Never grants access.
key_columns: owner_membership_id (creator; a personal view is visible to its owner only)
share_scope (workspace|brand|project) null + share_brand_id + share_project_id (exactly one scope when shared)
query jsonb (versioned AST, canonical serialization; at most 32 KiB)
presentation jsonb (columns in order, density; at most 8 KiB)
entities.notes: Phase 3A (ADR-26): a workspace-level record (core.record brand NULL; record scope is immutable) whose share names exactly one scope through share_brand_id/share_project_id. Running a view compiles the viewer's own predicate and field allow-list (0C AZ-26); a definition never grants access and a shared view returns each viewer's own rows. Lifecycle: delete is trash through the lifecycle service; views shared with a brand purge with the brand; views shared with a project are that project's content (trash, restore, purge). Pins and scope defaults are removed when the share changes. Phase 3B (ADR-28): the layout chooses how the one query result is rendered; layout options (board field, calendar date field and mode, timeline zoom, workload bucket) live in presentation. Every layout reads the same authorized record set.

entities.name: view_default
entities.purpose: Default view per user, brand, or project.
key_columns: target_key (the member, brand, or project id)
member_id | brand_id | project_id (exactly one, matching target_kind)
entities.notes: Phase 3A (ADR-26): resolution order is the person's own default, then the project's, then the brand's; a candidate the person cannot read is skipped silently. Brand and project defaults need views.configure and a view shared with the workspace or that brand or project. Project purge deletes its defaults.

entities.name: favorite
entities.purpose: Personal favorite or pin of a record or view, with order.
key_columns: record_id (core.record: a readable record or saved view)
target kind = the referenced core.record's registered record_type (joined, not copied)
rank text (fractional key, ≤ 64 chars; ties broken by record_id)
entities.notes: Phase 1E. A personal hint, never authority: every entry is re-authorized against the owner's current principal at display and activation, and unreadable, purged, or hidden-brand targets are omitted silently and removed opportunistically. At most FAVORITES_MAX per owner. Add and remove are idempotent; reorder moves one entry between two neighbours with a bounded fractional rank (rebalanced when a key would exceed its length).

entities.name: recent_item
entities.purpose: Recently viewed records (capped per person).
key_columns: target kind = the referenced core.record's registered record_type (joined, not copied)
entities.notes: Phase 1E. One row per owner and target holding the latest authorized visit; recorded only after a successful authorized render, coalesced within RECENT_VISIT_COALESCE, and trimmed to RECENT_ITEMS_MAX per owner in the same transaction. Re-authorized at display; clearable. Churn is not audited.

entities.name: view_state
entities.purpose: Persisted filters, sort, grouping, scroll anchor per person per view.
key_columns: device_key_hash bytea (SHA-256 of an opaque per-device key; never the key itself)
view_key text (registered route or view identity)
state jsonb (versioned, allow-listed fields; at most VIEW_STATE_MAX_BYTES)
expires_at timestamptz (VIEW_STATE_TTL after the last write)
entities.notes: Phase 1E. Durable per-device view state (RS-20): filters, sort, grouping, columns, density override, and the scroll anchor. Selection and open item are session-only and never stored here. Upserts are last-write-wins per device with an optional row-version precondition; expired rows are deleted on write and by the views cleanup job. Record identifiers inside the state are hints re-authorized on use. Phase 3A: keyed families `views.saved.<view id>` and `views.draft.task|project` share one schema (the current query and presentation as base64url JSON, plus the scroll anchor); the engine re-validates the query on every run.

entities.name: search_document
entities.purpose: Search projection per addressable record (and comment): text vectors plus scope and permission keys.

entities.name: index_status
entities.purpose: Per-record indexing state and last failure, visible to admins.

entities.name: recent_search
entities.purpose: Personal recent searches.

entities.name: metric_definition
entities.purpose: Versioned metric semantics with provenance and formula reference.

entities.name: metric_snapshot
entities.purpose: Pre-aggregated metric values per scope and period with freshness and completeness flags.

entities.name: dashboard
entities.purpose: Configured widgets over permission-filtered data; personal or shared.

entities.name: report_definition
entities.purpose: Saved report configuration and optional schedule.

entities.name: report_run
entities.purpose: Generated report output for a recipient and moment, authorized as the recipient.

entities.name: connection
entities.purpose: Authorized link to an external account (workspace or brand scope) with owner, scopes, status; credentials by secret reference only.

entities.name: calendar_event
entities.purpose: Personal mirror of an external calendar event (busy time, title per privacy), read-mostly, linked to a work block when two-way.

entities.name: connection_mapping
entities.purpose: Maps external resources (repository, calendar, project) to a brand and optional project.

entities.name: external_identity
entities.purpose: Identity of an external object linked to an internal record (sync identity).

entities.name: sync_run
entities.purpose: Operation detail of one sync: cursor range, counts, partial failures.

entities.name: sync_checkpoint
entities.purpose: Cursor per connection and resource, advanced by compare-and-set.

entities.name: sync_conflict
entities.purpose: Field changed on both sides; awaits resolution.

entities.name: inbound_endpoint
entities.purpose: Inbound webhook endpoint with verification secret reference.

entities.name: inbound_message
entities.purpose: Received inbound payload, deduplicated by provider event ID, processed via inbox.

entities.name: webhook_subscription
entities.purpose: Outbound webhook target, event filter, signing secret reference.

entities.name: webhook_delivery
entities.purpose: Outbound delivery attempts with response code and next retry.

entities.name: api_token
entities.purpose: API token metadata: prefix, hash, scopes, brand list, owner, expiry, last use. Secret shown once.

entities.name: oauth_client
entities.purpose: OAuth/MCP client registration for external assistants with granted scopes.

entities.name: import_job
entities.purpose: Operation detail of an import: mapping, preview, validation, progress, rollback window.

entities.name: import_mapping
entities.purpose: Saved reusable column mapping.

entities.name: import_row
entities.purpose: Per-row outcome with created/updated record and pre-import values for rollback.

entities.name: export_job
entities.purpose: Operation detail of an export: requested scope, authorized principal, files, expiry.

entities.name: export_file
entities.purpose: Materialized export artifact with format, object reference, requester epoch at materialization, expiry.
entities.notes: 0D §16.2: downloads re-authorize; an epoch change marks the export stale.

entities.name: test_case
entities.purpose: Manual or automated test definition in a brand, optionally a project.

entities.name: test_case_version
entities.purpose: Immutable steps and expected results; results reference the version executed.

entities.name: test_suite
entities.purpose: Named group of test cases.

entities.name: test_run
entities.purpose: One execution of cases against a version and environment, from any runner.

entities.name: test_result
entities.purpose: Outcome of one case version in one run (passed, failed, blocked, skipped, not_run, flaky) with expected/actual.

entities.name: flaky_classification
entities.purpose: Derived intermittent-failure classification per case over history.

entities.name: defect_detail
entities.purpose: Defect attributes for task_type = defect: severity, reproducibility, affected version, environment, origin result.

entities.name: verification_record
entities.purpose: Immutable verification of a defect fix: method (rerun|manual), result, version, environment, verifier.

entities.name: dev_link
entities.purpose: Link between a task/defect and an external code object (branch, commit, PR, issue, release, action run).

entities.name: external_fact
entities.purpose: Append-only fact reported by a provider (PR opened, review state, merged, CI conclusion, deployment) with provenance.

entities.name: environment
entities.purpose: Deployment target per brand (development, staging, production) with URLs.

entities.name: deployment
entities.purpose: Recorded deployment of a version to an environment.

entities.name: release
entities.purpose: Brand release with scope, readiness, deployed version, known issues.

entities.name: release_scope_item
entities.purpose: Included or excluded record in a release scope (same brand); snapshotted into each release decision.

entities.name: release_checklist_item
entities.purpose: Checklist item for a release; state snapshotted into each release decision.

entities.name: blocker_waiver
entities.purpose: Explicit waiver of a release blocker with approver and reason (immutable).

entities.name: release_decision
entities.purpose: Immutable go/no-go decision with approver, evidence snapshot references, supersedes link.

entities.name: template
entities.purpose: Reusable blueprint (workspace, project, task, document, automation, agent) at platform, workspace, or brand scope.
entities.notes: Platform templates live in a platform table with the same shape and no workspace_id. Phase 2D (ADR-24): task templates use the same immutable version rows; applying one needs an explicit brand (and optional project) and reports omissions.

entities.name: template_version
entities.purpose: Immutable template content package (typed, versioned schema).
key_columns: content jsonb (typed package; at most TEMPLATE_ITEMS_MAX items)
entities.notes: Phase 2A (ADR-21): serializations from projects strip personal data, collaborators, shares, activity/audit, secrets, unsupported later-module data, and cross-brand references.

entities.name: template_installation
entities.purpose: One installation: selected components, created records (via core.record.template_installation_id), sample flag.

entities.name: onboarding_progress
entities.purpose: Onboarding steps and first-value milestones per workspace and person.

entities.name: ai_provider_config
entities.purpose: Provider/model configuration, data settings; workspace keys by secret reference only.

entities.name: brand_ai_profile
entities.purpose: Brand AI instructions, terminology, audience, voice, approved-source policy.

entities.name: ai_action
entities.purpose: Operation detail for one assistant action: person, context scope, model, estimate, actual cost, output.

entities.name: ai_context_ref
entities.purpose: Record included or excluded from an AI action's context, with version and approval/staleness flags at use time.

entities.name: ai_output
entities.purpose: Generated content (answer, draft, summary) with statement-level citations; immutable.

entities.name: change_proposal
entities.purpose: Set of typed proposed changes from an AI action; application is a separate operation.

entities.name: proposed_change
entities.purpose: One typed change (create/update/relate) with target, base values, per-change decision, and application result.

entities.name: briefing_schedule
entities.purpose: Personal schedule for owner/brand briefings in a timezone.

entities.name: briefing
entities.purpose: Generated briefing for a recipient; every statement linked to sources.

entities.name: briefing_statement
entities.purpose: One statement with kind (fact, calculation, suggestion, unknown) and source references.

entities.name: briefing_correction
entities.purpose: User correction to a conclusion, scope personal or brand (OD-25).

entities.name: automation
entities.purpose: Trigger-condition-action automation at brand or workspace scope with declared target brands.

entities.name: automation_version
entities.purpose: Immutable validated definition (trigger, conditions, steps, branches).

entities.name: automation_run
entities.purpose: Operation detail of one run with triggering event and causation chain depth.

entities.name: automation_step_run
entities.purpose: Per-step state, inputs and outputs (redacted), error.

entities.name: agent_profile
entities.purpose: Agent definition: purpose, kind (internal|external), model, instructions, limits, approval policy.

entities.name: agent_scope_grant
entities.purpose: Explicit brands, projects, records, and integrations an agent may use.

entities.name: agent_tool_grant
entities.purpose: Tools and action classes an agent may invoke, with approval requirement per class.

entities.name: agent_connector
entities.purpose: External agent endpoint (API, webhook, MCP) with secret reference.

entities.name: agent_assignment
entities.purpose: Assignment of a task to an agent with structured context snapshot and run scope (agent scope ∩ assigner access).

entities.name: agent_run
entities.purpose: Operation detail of one agent execution for a task; returns artifacts; never completes the task.

entities.name: agent_tool_call
entities.purpose: One tool invocation: inputs/outputs (redacted), authorization result, duration, external effect link.

entities.name: artifact
entities.purpose: Output produced by a run (file, text, patch, link); becomes a deliverable only when returned as one.

entities.name: action_approval
entities.purpose: Approval gate for a classified agent action (external message, publish, spend, access, destructive, production, scope expansion).

entities.name: emergency_stop
entities.purpose: Workspace (or platform) stop switch for all agent execution; append-only toggles.

entities.name: support_request
entities.purpose: Support request with optional consented diagnostics.

entities.name: diagnostics_bundle
entities.purpose: Consented, redacted diagnostics snapshot attached to a request; expiring.

entities.name: feedback_item
entities.purpose: Bug report, feature request, or in-context feedback.

entities.name: platform_content
entities.purpose: Help articles, changelog entries, roadmap items, status incidents (platform-owned, public).

entities.name: account_preference
entities.purpose: Typed personal preferences that follow the account across workspaces and devices: theme, density, motion, shortcuts, start destination, record opening, hidden destinations.
entities.notes: Phase 1E. One row per account; a missing row means the defaults. Account-scoped (not workspace-personal) because appearance and input preferences apply before a workspace is chosen and on every device; device-local state (sidebar collapse, per-device scope default, scroll anchors) is not stored here. Deleted with the account. No field changes authority or exposure, so changes are not material audit events.

entities.name: view_pin
entities.purpose: A shared saved view pinned into workspace or brand navigation by someone allowed to configure views. Never grants access.
entities.notes: Phase 1E foundation; Phase 3A write path (ADR-26): pins are created and removed under views.configure at the pin's scope, and only for a view shared with that exact scope (workspace pin: workspace share; brand pin: that brand's share; a trigger repeats the rule). Unsharing or deleting a view removes its pins. Each pin is re-authorized at display.

entities.name: task_reminder
entities.purpose: A person's reminder about one task at one instant (personal; never changes the task).
entities.notes: Phase 2D (ADR-24): replaces the planned work.reminder. Firing is deduplicated by the state transition and writes a content-free outbox fact; delivery channels are 4B.

entities.name: task_snooze
entities.purpose: A person's snooze of one task until an instant (hides it from that person's reminder and Today surfaces; never changes dates).
entities.notes: Phase 2D (ADR-24). Not a meaningful update (OD-17).

entities.name: bulk_operation
entities.purpose: A previewed then executed bulk command over a bounded explicit set of tasks, with a per-item report.
key_columns: results jsonb (per item: id, outcome, code)
entities.notes: Phase 2D (ADR-24). Results carry identifiers and outcome codes only; unreadable items are reported as not_found without detail.

entities.name: undo_entry
entities.purpose: The inverse of one reversible task mutation, available to its actor for UNDO_WINDOW_SECONDS or until a conflicting change.
key_columns: targets jsonb (task id and expected version per target)
inverse jsonb (prior values of the changed fields only)
entities.notes: Phase 2D (ADR-24). Applying an undo is an audited inverse command with a new idempotency key and a version check; it never bypasses current authorization.

entities.name: capture_conversion
entities.purpose: Lineage of one triage or note conversion: the source Inbox item or note and the record it became.
entities.notes: Phase 2E (ADR-25).

entities.name: capacity_profile
entities.purpose: Per person: weekly capacity override and whether brand holidays reduce their availability.
key_columns: weekly_capacity_minutes null (override; else the working windows)
entities.notes: Phase 3E (ADR-30): the zone is the person's own (identity.account.timezone).
